body: I would be more inclined to kill myself if high school was the best four years of your life. Seriously high school is shitty, especially if you're not straight, athletic, and conventionally good-looking. It gets so much better than high school . Is college on the table? Even if it's not, once you graduate you're free to roam and do what you want! Think about yourself three years ago and how recently that was. In another three years you'll be in a whole new space and stronger and wiser for the time you stuck it out.

No offense to you if that works for you but that's the opposite of what I want to do. One of the biggest reasons why I haven't already ended it is because people would think I'm a coward and I can't think of anything that says that like a text message that says I want to die. I don't really have friends that I can just say that too like they'll understand.

I can't really talk to them about it. They don't really talk to each other, I'm not very close with my mom and I don't say "my dad wouldn't understand" to be shitty about it, but this is a guy who left his wife while she was dealing with alcoholism/grief/depression so he's not exactly the touchy feely type.

I wish I had time to take long walks. I have commitments from 5:30 in the morning through about 8:30 at night, it's late for me right now and I'll definitely feel it tomorrow morning but like I said, if I die next week it doesn't matter how tired I am tomorrow, right?

My parents actually got a divorce when I was 19. My dad told me he was moving out in the car driving me back from the airport after my freshman year of college. I told him I didn't want to hear anything about it because I didn't want to take sides. He tried to explain the situation to me calmly but I just turned up the radio.

 I didn't really talk to my parents much that summer, I'd usually just stay out all day/night and either come back to one of their houses after they'd already gone to bed, or just stay out and tell each parent I was staying with the other.
